name: claude-for-pm-intro-video
description: Renders the README intro video frame by frame with @napi-rs/canvas and ffmpeg.

scripts.mp4: node render.js | ffmpeg -y -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgba -s 1280x720 -r 30 -i - -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 20 -preset slow -movflags +faststart ../assets/intro.mp4
scripts.gif: STILL_BG=1 node render.js | ffmpeg -y -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgba -s 1280x720 -r 30 -i - -vf "fps=15,scale=960:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" ../assets/intro.gif
